description: This file defines the RespWriterWrapper struct which wraps an http.ResponseWriter to track bytes written, status code, errors, and to invoke a callback on write. It provides methods for writing data, headers, flushing, and retrieving internal state.

classes.name: RespWriterWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around http.ResponseWriter to monitor write operations, status, and errors.

methods.name: NewRespWriterWrapper
methods.description: Creates a new RespWriterWrapper with a specified ResponseWriter and callback function.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes bytes to the underlying ResponseWriter, updates metrics, and calls the callback.

methods.name: WriteHeader
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code and records it for span attribution.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Internal method to persist the status code and call the underlying WriteHeader.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the ResponseWriter if it supports flushing, ensuring headers are written first.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes written.

methods.name: StatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code that was sent.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the last error encountered during writing.
